name: Hermann Muller
features: fair skin, light brown hair, blue eyes, square blunt face, strong jaw, compact muscular build, plain steady expression
bio: Hermann Paul Müller came to Auto Union from motorcycles, having taken the German sidecar title in 1932 and the 500cc title in 1936. He won the 1939 French Grand Prix at Reims and led the European Championship on points when war stopped the season — a title never formally awarded to him.
